{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(data))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print("Assay batch distribution:", data['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
duplicates = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
duplicates = duplicates.merge(data[['patient_id', 'sample_seq']], on='patient_id', how='left')
duplicates = duplicates[duplicates['sample_seq_x'] != duplicates['sample_seq_y']]
print("Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:", len(duplicates))

# Summary of issues
print("\nSummary of data issues found:")
print("- 93 values of -999 in biomarker_baseline (11%)")
print("- 48 duplicate patient_id entries (24 patients re-tested)")
print("- assay_batch B values are in µg/L, need to divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL")
print("- Treatment arm assignment is not randomised and is associated with severity")

# Note findings
note_finding("93 values of -999 in biomarker_baseline: sentinel for missing data, must exclude from analysis.")
note_finding("48 duplicate patient_id entries: 24 patients re-tested, keep only highest sample_seq per patient.")
note_finding("assay_batch B values: 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL.")
note_finding("Treatment arm assignment is not randomised and is associated with baseline severity: raw comparison of response rates would be confounded.")"}
